text:
Maya: Helios Systems requested a performance PoC. Requirements: sustained 400 qps per primary region for gen calls, avg ~320 tokens (max 512), p95 < 120ms end-to-end (post-auth). They want Dedicated capacity and will require VPC peering + customer-managed KMS for compliance. Can we carve out time next week?

Evan: Quick check: which regions? Any DR region? Also are they ok with quantized models?

Maya: Primary: us-west-2, DR: ap-southeast-1. They prefer a 7B-class model and accept quantization. Steady 30m holds, occasional 5s microbursts. Mostly single-turn generation but heavy prefix reuse (~64 tokens).

Zoe: Plan proposal: rwd-open-7b q8_256 as baseline. Infra: 3 nodes/region (2 active + 1 spare) on A10GX-equivalents in dedicated pool. Tests: ramp 0->400 qps over 4-5m, hold 30m, inject 8 microbursts of 5s. Capture p50/p95/p99, cold-starts, GPU util, tokens/sec, HTTP error rates.

Zoe: Test harness example (k6 + small client):
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m helios_poc.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
```

Evan: KMS note: customer-managed KMS over VPN/DirectConnect may add latency. Estimate +8-20ms depending on topology. Helios demands p95 <120ms after auth, so we must simulate customer KMS path and measure delta.

Maya: Ops: can we support a hosted-dedicated run and a short VPC smoke test to measure networking delta? Helios needs that evidence to sign contract.

ops-bot: Tentative slot available Mon 2026-04-06 08:00 PT. Please confirm within 48h to reserve 3 nodes/region.

Zoe: Ballpark pricing: 3 nodes/region -> 6 nodes total live footprint. With redundancy and spare, estimate X/hr per node => ~6*X/hr baseline. Monthly committed (12mo) with standard enterprise discount approx $Z/month; VPC + egress add-on increases cost by ~P%. I'll provide exact SKU and tokens/sec (expected ~128k tokens/sec/region at 400 qps, avg 320 tokens) in the final writeup.

billing-bot: Billing: to give committed pricing we need SKU IDs, expected sustained hours/month, and whether the spare nodes are billed when idle. Also note VPC private link incurs one-time setup fee and recurring peering charges.

Zoe: Runbook excerpt I'll include in GH: reserve infra, deploy q8_256, enable prefix caching, warmup 50 qps for 10m, ramp to 400, hold 30m, run microbursts, capture per-request logs and GPU traces. If p95 >120ms, fallback actions: increase nodes, switch quant profile to lower-latency profile, or route a percentage of requests to smaller model variant.

Maya: Deliverables for Helios: 1) perf run report (latency percentiles, throughput curves), 2) cost comparison hosted-dedicated vs private-VPC, 3) runbook and dashboard snapshot, 4) short screen recording of tail latency behavior, 5) security questionnaire answers. I'll confirm schedule with Helios and reply by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
